sections.title: Wild Things: Children’s Literature and the Psychoanalytic Study of the Child
sections.description: This course, framed as a psychoanalytic study of the child, focuses on English-language children’s literature from the 19th Century to the present. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
